question: Using FIFO, calculate the value of closing stock of 58 units. The latest purchase was 141 units at R54 each. The previous purchase was 249 units at R25 each.

question: Opening stock: 267 units. Purchases: 682 units. Returns to suppliers: 45 units. Sales: 577 units. Stock counted at year end: 308 units. Calculate the number of missing units.
explanation: Expected stock = Opening (267) + Purchases (682) - Returns (45) - Sales (577) = 327. Missing = Expected - Counted (308) = 19 units.
